definitions.explanation: A camera that records images electronically rather than on film. Used for the full category, from compact point-and-shoots to mirrorless and DSLR cameras.

examples.japanese: デジタルカメラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えた→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧デジタルカメラ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{画質|がしつ}→画質：16156_gashitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: This digital camera has very good image quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{軽|かる}くて→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{高画質|こうがしつ}→高画質：23668_kougashitsu⟧なデジタルカメラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a light, high-quality digital camera for travel.

notes:
Full form of ⟦デジカメ→デジカメ：28543_dejikame⟧. Used in writing, product specifications, and more formal contexts; in conversation, people usually say ⟦デジカメ→デジカメ：28543_dejikame⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- デジタルカメラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a digital camera
- デジタルカメラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画質|がしつ}→画質：16156_gashitsu⟧: digital-camera image quality
- ⟦{高性能|こうせいのう}→高性能：16282_kouseinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧デジタルカメラ: high-performance digital camera
